acceptanceMapping.evidence: Exact GET paths, RETIREMENT variant, four filter groups, eight sorts, stable default tie-break, limit 1..100 and four query cardinality states are sealed in both layers.
Seven-layer PEP, trusted tenant/population, pre-serialization VIEW/MASK/OMIT, exact counts, revision-bound cursor and correlated problems are covered.
One case UUID is the item identity, availableActions is always empty and runId/packId are absent from the projection and UI.
PAY-003 signed-pack state and action ownership remain unchanged; PAY-004 only binds exact immutable pack facts.
V50 calculation and PayrollCalculated.v1 remain unchanged; no retirement calculation endpoint, command or event exists.
Exact append-only states, legal transitions, terminal immutability, maker-checker and linked correction are enforced in domain and PostgreSQL.
V55 creates exactly the five leased tables and introduces no receipt, outbox, audit, seed or backfill.
All five tables have tenant-first identities, PUBLIC revocation, least privilege, ENABLE/FORCE RLS and mutation rejection.
Exact same-worker V50 and exact ACTIVE/NOT_REQUIRED policy lineage fail closed for stale, cross-scope, cross-worker, mutable-latest or missing facts.
Canonical NUMERIC(19,4), explicit currency, Foundation-bound mode, closed application stage and equivalent Java/SQL digests prevent database rounding and floating-point use.
Owner receipts, CAS, audit and outbox stores remain unchanged; blocked pack states cannot produce a result or fall back.
All seven UI states, accessibility, responsive widths, 200 percent zoom, themes, reduced motion and default-OFF zero-call behavior are covered without mounting the route.
